subject: Pilot invoice timing & crediting — residency/HSM add-ons
messages:
From: Megan Lowell <megan@procurecorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot billing cadence + credits question

Hi Tessa,

Quick question on the pilot SOW — our procurement team is reviewing the invoice schedule and they'd like clarity on two items before signing:

1) Can Redwood invoice the residency and HSM one-time activation as a milestone (30% at kickoff / 70% at handover) rather than billing the full add-on upfront?
2) For the pilot credits you offered (10k token credit + 50% discount on audit logs for first 90 days), is that applied as an invoice credit line or reflected as an operational discount during the pilot? Our finance prefers credits applied to the first invoice so it’s visible in the PO.

I attached the SOW they circulated and a sample invoice template. Megan (procurement lead) is on copy: contracts@sagehealth.io.

Can you advise by EOD Monday? We’re trying to keep the signing timeline this week.

Thanks,
Megan
Megan Lowell
Procurement Manager
Sage Health

Attachments: SageHealth_Pilot_SOW_v1.pdf, sample_invoice_template.xlsx

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sage Health <contracts@sagehealth.io>, Megan Lowell <megan@procurecorp.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Aug 2026 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credits question

Hi Megan — thanks for the note and for flagging procurement’s preference. Quick answers up front: yes on milestone invoicing for activation fees; and we can represent the pilot credits as an invoice-level credit applied to the first commercial invoice.

Details / proposal:
- Residency & HSM activation: we can split the one-time activation into 30% at kickoff, 70% at handover (handover = network enablement + audit evidence delivered). We will reflect the milestone terms in the SOW.
- Pilot credits: we’ll show the 10k token credit and the 50% audit-log discount as separate credit line items on invoice #1 (so they appear on the PO). For bookkeeping, credits will reduce the invoice amount rather than change unit list prices.
- True-up: if usage exceeds credits during the pilot, we’ll do a single true-up invoice at pilot close; if usage is below credits we’ll carry forward unused credit for 60 days.

I’ve attached a draft invoice schedule (invoice_schedule_draft.xlsx) with the milestone breakdown and example credit lines. Ben, can you confirm we’re comfortable amortizing the activation recognition this way from a revenue ops perspective? Laura, flag any CS dependencies for handover evidence delivery (audit logs + KMS keys rotation proof).

If that works for Sage, I can update the SOW and route a DocuSign with the milestone invoicing language today.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
T: 415-555-0123

Attachments: invoice_schedule_draft.xlsx

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credits question

Tessa — ok from finance ops side with a small caveat. We can accept milestone invoicing for the activation fees, but for revenue recognition we need the handover deliverable to be specific: 1) residency provisioning complete, 2) HSM key provisioning confirmed, and 3) audit log schema + initial retention snapshot exported to confirm ingestion. That gives us a clear recognition event for the 70%.

On the credit side, invoice-level credits are fine. Two operational asks:
- Make the credit lines explicit ("Pilot token credit — 10,000 tokens at list = -$X") rather than a generic discount so AP has a clean line to match to the PO.
- Add an explicit clause that any unused token credit expires 60 days after pilot end and is non-refundable.

If we want to be conservative on margin, we can also propose splitting the audit-log discount: 50% for first 90 days as discussed, then 25% for the subsequent 90 days if they convert to a 12-month commitment. That’s optional but helps our economics for early pilot conversions.

Laura — can you confirm the handover checklist and whether we can produce the initial audit retention snapshot within 5 business days of provisioning?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Sales Finance
Redwood Inference

From: Megan Lowell <megan@procurecorp.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sage Health <contracts@sagehealth.io>
Date: Tue, 31 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot billing cadence + credits question

Thanks Tessa / Ben — that approach is workable for Sage Health. Two small confirmations so our PO team can proceed:

1) Please include the explicit credit line language Ben suggested and the 60-day expiry clause for unused token credits in the SOW.
2) We’re happy to accept milestone 30/70 for the activation fee conditioned on the handover checklist (residency, HSM, audit snapshot).

One additional ask from legal: can we add an invoice payment term of Net 45 (instead of Net 30) for the first invoice only, to accommodate internal approvals? If Redwood can accept Net 45 for invoice #1, we’ll issue the PO today and sign.

If Net 45 is ok, please send the updated SOW/Docusign link and we’ll route on our side.

Best,
Megan
Procurement Manager
Sage Health
